seoDescription: The three pillars of Gamma Capital: Education, Technology, Community. Tools for understanding and analysis, no personalised advice.
heroSubtitle: The three pillars of Gamma Capital
heroDescription: Our work is organised around three complementary pillars. Each is designed to provide tools for understanding and analysis. No personalised advice: the member always decides autonomously.

solutions.title: Education & Masterclass
solutions.description: Structured masterclasses on options, institutional flow, GEX, quantitative AI, and smart-money logic. Institutional material reframed for self-learning.

solutions.title: Quant Tech & AI Tools
solutions.description: Proprietary analytical tools: flow scanner, GEX dashboard, AI models. Everything is self-service: the member sees the data, operational conclusions remain theirs. Tools are included in the Discord Membership.

solutions.title: Discord Community
solutions.description: A private community of serious investors. Collaborative research, daily commentary, periodic events. All content is identical for members of the same tier.

solutions.title: Real Estate Insights
solutions.description: Analysis and content on real estate markets (focus on Switzerland and Italy). Educational and market material — not regulated real-estate advice. Distributed in general form.
features: Lugano, Chiasso, Como, Venice, Udine, Rome

solutions.title: Network
solutions.description: Gamma Capital operates within a selective network of professionals across finance, real estate and alternative investments. Not a service, but a context for discussion and research.

ctaDescription: Explore our pillars or contact us to find your way. We do not offer personalised advice: the first contact is only meant to clarify which self-service path best suits you.
